issues.title: q15 hero-row pan fabrics do not match y_47300, and the diamond pan is a bold light-star field

The E pan diamond at 1:1: L101 vs the photo's F diamond pan 74 (1.37x light), p10 70 vs 54, coverage 0.21 vs 0.08, blob mean 33 vs 5 px, p90 119 vs 9. It is the most eye-catching fabric error in q15, and the same bold stars show on the q16 near seats.
issues.fix: 09a_econ.js l.11: econPan list [yFabric, yFabricD, yFabricC, yFabric, yFabricB] -> [yFabricD, yFabricB, yFabric, yFabricC, yFabric]. The index sequence for n=4 rot=1 is 3,1,4,2, so k0..k3 become mosaic / diamond / tick / tick, i.e. camera L->R tick / tick / diamond / mosaic. The mix stays tick x2 + one each of the others, and econUnitFar l.346 follows automatically. Add a pan-only diamond in 09a_econ.js: const ECON_PAN_B = { ...SEATMAT.yFabricB, c: photoBase('#4a5688', 'y_diamond') } (~25 % darker), used where PF === SEATMAT.yFabricB (l.53 and l.346), so the up-facing pan does not out-shine the back. If the layer gain can be set per material, halve the motif amplitude on it. Targets on the q15 F pan: L 72-80, coverage(1.4x med) <= 0.10, blob mean <= 8 px, p90/p10 1.8-2.0.

issues.title: Petal fleck too weak at row distance (coverage and size now right)
issues.evidence: q15 1:1 E / G backs: p90/p10 2.48 vs 3.05, fl/gr 1.99 vs 2.26, hpCV 0.37 vs 0.50, B/R 2.07 vs 2.28. Coverage 0.20 vs 0.20 and blobs 3.5 vs 3.8 px are on target. Close e4 pad coverage 0.21 vs 0.13.
issues.fix: test/make_swatches.py y_fleck: core exponent 1.2 -> 1.0 and fleck peak +15 % (bright = m + 1.15 * (r - m) inside the fleck mask) so the flecks get brighter, not bigger. Ground 5 % darker and bluer (SEATMAT.yFabricD #444d6b -> #414b70; shared, one line). Do not dilate. Targets q15 E / G: p90/p10 2.9-3.1, fl/gr 2.2-2.3, coverage 0.19-0.22, B/R 2.2-2.3. The close-up thinning (drop ~40 % of the components at random, seeded) remains the fix for e4 coverage 0.21 -> 0.14-0.16, and only if it keeps the q15 coverage >= 0.18.

issues.title: Tick strokes 1.4x fat, coverage 1.5x at matched scale
issues.fix: test/make_swatches.py y_tick: thin the strokes rather than dim them - erode the above-median stroke mask 1 px at tile resolution, or r_hi = m + (r - m) * ((r - m) / (rmax - m)) ** 0.3. Then restore the peak so p90/p10 holds (strokes m + 0.8 -> 0.9 * (r - m)). Targets q15 D / F: coverage 0.17-0.20, blob mean 2.6-3.0 px, p90/p10 3.3-3.6; e4 p90/p10 4.0-4.2.
